name: sflag_set_layout
description: S-flag set: option [0x03, 0x05, 0x80, expiry u32 BE] parses with store-and-forward requested. Oracle: spec/05-routing.md 9.8 (independent, spec-derived).

name: sflag_clear
description: Flags 0x00: option parses but no store-and-forward intent. Oracle: spec/05-routing.md 9.8 (independent, spec-derived).

name: reserved_bits_ignored_on_receive
description: Reserved bits in the flags byte MUST be ignored on receive (spec 9.8): flags 0x7F has S=0 and must parse as no-store, not as a reject. Oracle: spec/05-routing.md 9.8 (independent, spec-derived).

name: expiry_big_endian_decode
description: Absolute expiry is a 4-byte big-endian Unix timestamp: bytes 0x000001E8 decode to 488. Oracle: spec/05-routing.md 9.8 (independent, spec-derived).

name: expired_with_valid_clock
description: Node with valid wall clock: expiry < now -> drop silently (spec 9.8 Absolute TTL). Oracle: spec/05-routing.md 9.8 (independent, spec-derived).

name: clockless_fail_open
description: Node without valid wall-clock time MUST NOT drop based on expiry alone; store or forward so downstream nodes with valid time enforce expiry (R-05-080). Oracle: spec/05-routing.md 9.8 (independent, spec-derived).

name: wrong_length_rejected
description: Option length != 5 is malformed for Type=0x03 and the option must not be accepted as a DTN intent. Oracle: spec/05-routing.md 9.8 (independent, spec-derived).
